```sql
select
  NULL as key,
  cast(sum(rf.processed_on - rf.business_date) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from refunds rf
join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
left join payment_attempts a on a.attempt_id = rf.attempt_id
where not o.is_test
  and (a.attempt_id is null or not a.is_test)
  and rf.status = 'processed'
  and rf.processed_on between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
  and s.region_id in ('IN-TN')
  and ci.name = 'Chennai'
order by value
```
